<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Aptos,sans-serif"><b>Observability &amp; Monitoring &bull; Architect and operate enterprise-scale observability platforms on AWS/Azure, covering microservices, Lambda/serverless functions, and Kubernetes-based workloads. &bull; Build full-stack observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, and Fluentd &mdash; covering metrics, logs, and distributed traces. &bull; Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets; build actionable dashboards and alerting policies aligned to business and technical objectives. &bull; Standardize application logging across engineering codebases by designing and championing reusable Python logging modules and log aggregation pipelines. &bull; Instrument applications and services with distributed tracing to identify performance bottlenecks and reduce MTTR. Automation &amp; SRE &bull; Design and build reusable automation frameworks standardized as team-wide baselines for all operational automation development. &bull; Automate high-volume operational workflows (ServiceNow tickets, VDI lifecycle, user provisioning) using Python, PowerShell, and REST APIs. &bull; Implement zero-touch automation with approval and rollback mechanisms, Managed Identity security controls, and audit logging. &bull; Build and own CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, and Azure DevOps for fast, safe software delivery. &bull; Provision and manage infrastructure using Terraform and CloudFormation, enforcing IaC standards across the organization. Cloud Platform Engineering &bull; Design and operate Kubernetes-based workloads on AWS EKS and Azure AKS, supporting high-transaction production environments. &bull; Optimize cloud costs and platform performance &mdash; including PostgreSQL query tuning, Redis-based retry workflows, and Lambda function efficiency. &bull; Integrate automation services securely using Azure API Management (APIM) and AWS API Gateway as governed entry points. &bull; Ensure enterprise security compliance using IAM, RBAC, Azure Managed Identity, and secure API design patterns reviewed by Security and Architecture teams. Incident Management &amp; Reliability &bull; Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) for critical production incidents, ensuring 100% uptime SLAs for mission-critical workloads. &bull; Develop and maintain incident response runbooks, post-mortem processes, and reliability improvement roadmaps. &bull; Proactively identify and resolve performance degradation, capacity risks, and reliability gaps before they impact production. 	<div>IT &middot; Development Team</div>

	<div>Overview</div>

	<div>Location: Hybrid - Wed/Thurs in office &middot; Hyderabad</div>

	<div>Job Title</div>

	<div>Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)</div>

	<div>Experience Required</div>

	<div>&bull; Extracted: &ldquo;4-7 Years of overall experience&rdquo; / &ldquo;4+ years of experience in QA automation&rdquo; (maximum 7 years</div>

	<div>of experience)</div>

	<div>Overview</div>

	<div>Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) role focused on building and maintaining automation test</div>

	<div>suites and performing functional, regression, and integration testing across UI, backend, APIs, batch jobs,</div>

	<div>databases, and AWS resources. The role emphasizes end-to-end workflow automation, CI/CD integration, and</div>

	<div>maintaining testing documentation and artifacts. Requires strong programming (Java or Python), shell scripting,</div>

	<div>and experience with modern automation frameworks (Playwright/Selenium).</div>

	<div>Key Responsibilities</div>

	<div>&bull; Design, develop, and maintain automation test suites using Playwright and shell scripting</div>

	<div>&bull; Perform functional, regression, and integration testing across UI, database, batch jobs, and AWS resources</div>

	<div>&bull; Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and ensure high-quality deliverables</div>

	<div>&bull; Automate complex end-to-end workflows and improve test coverage</div>

	<div>&bull; Coordinate end-to-end testing across different product and domain teams</div>

	<div>&bull; Support CI/CD pipelines and integrate automated tests into the development lifecycle</div>

	<div>&bull; Contribute to and maintain testing documentation, standards, and best practices</div>

	<div>&bull; Participate in code reviews and provide feedback to improve quality and maintainability</div>

	<div>&bull; Propose new approaches to enhance automation efficiency and effectiveness</div>

	<div>&bull; Document automation workflow design/steps/usage; create user guides/runbooks</div>

	<div>&bull; Document and track test artifacts in tools such as Jira and source-code control (automation scripts)</div>

	<div>&bull; Maintain tools used in test development (source control, test management, release systems)</div>

	<div>&bull; Develop and maintain requirements traceability matrices</div>

	<div>&bull; Communicate obstacles to avoid impediments and timeline disruption</div>

	<div>&bull; Perform manual testing as required</div>

	<div>Required Qualifications</div>

	<div>&bull; BE/B.Tech in any relevant stream</div>

	<div>&bull; 4+ years of experience in QA automation with focus on modern frameworks</div>

	<div>&bull; Strong programming in Java or Python</div>

	<div>&bull; Strong shell scripting</div>

	<div>&bull; Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript</div>

	<div>&bull; Experience with database queries</div>

	<div>&bull; Experience with Linux environment</div>

	<div>&bull; Experience testing backend, APIs, and web-based UI applications</div>

	<div>&bull; Experience with JMeter or other performance testing tools</div>

	<div>&bull; Solid understanding of AWS services</div>

	<div>&bull; Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI)</div>

	<div>&bull; Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; attention to detail</div>

	<div>&bull; Strong communication skills; ability to work in a fast-paced agile environment</div>

<h1 style="text-indent:-0.5pt"><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="line-height:107%"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">ROLE OVERVIEW </span></span></span></span></h1>

<p style="text-indent:0cm; margin-left:1px"><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="line-height:107%"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><span style="color:black"><b>&nbsp;</b></span></span></span></span></p>

<p style="text-indent:-0.5pt; margin-left:1px"><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="line-height:103%"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">This individual will provide comprehensive technical guidance and NetSuite Functional expertise to the project teams and will need to have project estimation experience and be able to communicate effectively with both technical resources and non-technical business users. <b>We are seeking a motivated self-starter who must be able to work well both independently and with the US client teams.</b></span></span></span></span></p>

<p style="text-indent:-0.5pt; margin-left:1px">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-indent:-0.5pt; margin-left:1px">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-indent:0cm; margin-left:1px"><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="line-height:107%"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><span style="color:black"><b>Role Summary</b>: </span></span></span></span></p>

<p style="text-indent:0cm; margin-left:1px">&nbsp;</p>

<ul>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="line-height:103%"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">The Functional Consultant will be responsible for working directly with customers to document and validate their business requirements and map them to NetSuite functionality.</span></span></span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="line-height:103%"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">&nbsp;In addition, the Functional Consultant will work with the customer to configure/customize NetSuite application to meet their business requirements. </span></span></span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="line-height:103%"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">Candidate will be required to conduct sessions with the customer over the web conference, attend project meetings and provide status on progress of activities and deliverables. </span></span></span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="line-height:103%"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">Functional Consultant will provide customers with as needed consulting and general assistance and be a &#39;go-to&#39; resource for specific functional areas. </span></span></span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="line-height:103%"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">Contribution to the solutions repository/best practices and knowledge share activities are required as well as participation in the Subject Matter Expert programs.</span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Aptos,sans-serif">Job Description - Business Systems Analyst (BSA)<br />
Location: 1 Offshore (Trivandrum/Kochi)<br />
Experience: 7-12 years<br />
Domain: Annuities / Insurance<br />
Role Summary<br />
We are looking for high caliber Business Systems Analysts (BSAs) who are strong problem solvers and effective collaborators, with the ability to leverage AI tools to work smarter and faster. The ideal candidate combines solid business analysis fundamentals with modern, AI assisted ways of working to deliver high quality outcomes efficiently.&nbsp;<b>Annuity is the priority.</b><br />
Key Responsibilities<br />
Partner with business stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document requirements across business and technology teams<br />
Translate business needs into clear user stories, functional specifications, and process flows<br />
Collaborate closely with engineering, QA, and architecture teams to ensure requirements are understood and implemented correctly<br />
Act as a bridge between business and technology, ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, and outcomes<br />
AI enabled, fast-moving professional<br />
Strong hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude Code) to accelerate analysis, documentation, and solution design<br />
Uses AI to offload lower value tasks and focus on high value, complex problem solving and stakeholder conversations<br />
Support UAT planning and execution, including test case reviews and defect triage<br />
Identify process gaps and recommend practical, scalable improvements<br />
Strong data analysis and data mapping skills, with a profile close to a Data Analyst<br />
Advanced SQL, solid database concepts, and experience with APIs and integrations<br />
Technical and analytical background Former developers with strong systems analysis skills are highly preferred<br />
Able to analyze problems quickly and produce high quality outputs at speed<br />
7+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst / Business Analyst<br />
Preferred .<br />
Experience in Annuities, Retirement Services, Insurance.<br />
Familiarity with Agile / SAFe delivery models<br />
Exposure to platforms such as policy administration systems, data platforms, or digital portals<br />
Experience working in onsite-offshore delivery models<br />
Comfort reviewing technical designs and API level flows (no coding required)</span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;,serif"><b><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:10.0pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">Position Overview</span></span></span></span></b></span></span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;,serif"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:10.0pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">The Company Secretary, will play a pivotal role in ensuring statutory compliance, corporate governance, and effective coordination between the Board, Management, and regulatory authorities.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;,serif"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:10.0pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">This position will also manage all corporate secretarial functions, ensuring that the organization adheres to legal standards and in-house policies. This position requires meticulous attention to detail and expert knowledge of corporate governance.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;,serif"><b><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:10.0pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">Key Responsibilities</span></span></span></span></b></span></span></span></p>

<ol style="list-style-type:lower-alpha">

</ol>

<ul>
	<li style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;,serif"><span style="font-size:10.0pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, SEBI regulations, and other applicable laws</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
	<li style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;,serif"><span style="font-size:10.0pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">File statutory returns and forms with the Registrar of Companies (ROC) and other authorities</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>

<h3 style="text-align:justify; margin-top:11px; margin-bottom:5px">&nbsp;</h3>

<h3 style="text-align:justify; margin-top:11px; margin-bottom:5px"><span style="font-size:14pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;,serif"><span style="color:#0f4761"><span style="font-weight:normal"><strong><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:10.0pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">Position Overview</span></span></span></span></strong></span></span></span></span></span></h3>

<h3 style="text-align:justify; margin-top:11px; margin-bottom:5px"><span style="font-size:14pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;,serif"><span style="color:#0f4761"><span style="font-weight:normal"><span style="font-size:10.0pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif">The position is responsible for leading the organization&rsquo;s financial strategy, ensuring regulatory compliance, and maintaining strong fiscal governance. Acting as a key advisor to the Management and Key Leadership.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></h3>

<h3 style="text-align:justify; margin-top:11px; margin-bottom:5px">&nbsp;</h3>

<h3 style="text-align:justify; margin-top:11px; margin-bottom:5px"><span style="font-size:14pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;,serif"><span style="color:#0f4761"><span style="font-weight:normal"><span style="font-size:10.0pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif">The role covers financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, accounting, audits, and risk management, while ensuring accuracy and transparency in financial reporting. </span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></h3>

<h3 style="text-align:justify; margin-top:11px; margin-bottom:5px"><span style="font-size:14pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;,serif"><span style="color:#0f4761"><span style="font-weight:normal"><strong><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:10.0pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:black">Key Responsibilities</span></span></span></span></strong></span></span></span></span></span></h3>

<ol style="list-style-type:lower-alpha">
	<li style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;,serif"><b><span style="font-size:10.0pt"><span style="line-height:115%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif">Strategic Finance &amp; Leadership</span></span></span></b></span></span></span></li>
</ol>

<ul>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="line-height:107%"><span style="font-family:Aptos,sans-serif"><b>Additional Value Adds</b></span></span></span></p>

<ul>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="tab-stops:list 36.0pt"><span style="line-height:107%"><span style="font-family:Aptos,sans-serif">Experience with Amazon Ads tools (Campaign Manager, DSP, Ad Console, AMC)</span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
<span style="font-size:11.0pt"><span style="line-height:107%"><span style="font-family:&quot;Aptos&quot;,sans-serif">Experience supporting enterprise advertisers or large-scale ad programs</span></span></span>71:T486f,<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:#0a0a0a">A <b><span style="background:yellow">colocation to public cloud migration</span></b> program is&nbsp;a structured, phased initiative designed to move infrastructure, applications, and data from private, rented data centers (colocation) to public cloud providers&nbsp;(e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). This process involves assessing workload dependencies, optimizing for cloud-native architectures, and ensuring minimal downtime, often resulting in lower TCO, enhanced scalability, and increased flexibility.&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="line-height:21.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:15.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:#001d35">Key Components of a Migration Program</span></span></span></b></span></span></span></span></p>

<ul>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="color:#0a0a0a"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="tab-stops:list 36.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Assessment &amp; Planning:</span></span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;Identifying dependencies, data sovereignty requirements, and workload compatibility (e.g., rehosting vs. refactoring).</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="color:#0a0a0a"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="tab-stops:list 36.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Landing Zone Construction:</span></span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;Creating a secure, compliant, and scalable environment within the public cloud before moving workloads.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="color:#0a0a0a"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="tab-stops:list 36.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Execution (Migration Waves):</span></span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;Executing structured migration waves, often using tools like&nbsp;<a href="https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/publicsector/colocation-of-aws-remove-the-friction-from-cloud-migration/" style="color:#0563c1; text-decoration:underline" target="_blank"><span style="color:#1a0dab">AWS Application Migration Service</span></a>&nbsp;to migrate VMware environments, reducing complexity.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="tab-stops:list 36.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:#0a0a0a">Decommissioning:</span></span></span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:#0a0a0a">&nbsp;Removing hardware from the physical data center after validation and testing.&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="line-height:21.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:15.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:#001d35">Strategic Approaches to Migration</span></span></span></b></span></span></span></span></p>

<ul>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="color:#0a0a0a"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="tab-stops:list 36.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Phased Migration:</span></span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;Moving workloads in stages rather than all at once to manage risk.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="color:#0a0a0a"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="tab-stops:list 36.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Hybrid IT Integration:</span></span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;Utilizing direct, high-speed connections between existing colocation facilities and public clouds (e.g., Equinix Fabric or&nbsp;CoreSite Open Cloud Exchange) to facilitate data transfer.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="color:#0a0a0a"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="tab-stops:list 36.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">7 R&#39;s Framework:</span></span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;Applying strategies such as Rehost, Replatform, or Refactor to maximize cloud benefit, as outlined in&nbsp;<a href="https://www.ibm.com/think/insights/7-rs-cloud-migration" style="color:#0563c1; text-decoration:underline" target="_blank"><span style="color:#1a0dab">IBM&#39;s cloud migration guide</span></a>.&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="line-height:21.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:15.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:#001d35">Benefits &amp; Considerations</span></span></span></b></span></span></span></span></p>

<ul>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="color:#0a0a0a"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="tab-stops:list 36.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Cost Efficiency:</span></span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;Shifting from fixed capital expenditure (CapEx) for hardware to variable operating expenditure (OpEx), reducing TCO by 30-40%.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="color:#0a0a0a"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="tab-stops:list 36.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Compliance Control:</span></span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;Maintaining compliance with regulations (HIPAA, PCI-DSS) during transition.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="color:#0a0a0a"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="tab-stops:list 36.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Speed:</span></span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;Accelerating migration through automation, sometimes reducing multi-year projects to months.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
	<li><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="color:#0a0a0a"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="tab-stops:list 36.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Risk:</span></span></b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;Managing application dependencies to avoid, as&nbsp;<a href="https://www.netscout.com/blog/colocation-migration-how-ramp-cloud-without-crashing" style="color:#0563c1; text-decoration:underline" target="_blank"><span style="color:#1a0dab">Netscout</span></a>&nbsp;warns, accidental downtime of mission-critical services.</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="background:yellow"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:#0a0a0a">Migration and decommissioning</span></span></span></span><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:#0a0a0a"> involve&nbsp;transferring data or workloads to new, efficient systems (like cloud or modern ERP) and safely shutting down, removing, or archiving legacy hardware/software. This process reduces operational costs, mitigates security risks from outdated systems, ensures compliance, and optimizes IT landscapes.&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="background:white"><span style="line-height:18.0pt"><span style="font-family:Calibri,sans-serif"><b><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="color:#0a0a0a">Key Aspects of Migration &amp; Decommissioning:</span></span></span></b></span></span></span></span></p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>90:T8d0,<p>&nbsp;<b>Techno-Functional</b>&nbsp;consultant [<b>Workday Adaptive Planning</b>]</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>Key Responsibilities:</p>

<ul type="disc">
	<li>Lead end-to-end design, configuration, and deployment of changes</li>
	<li>Design solution to implement new requirements</li>
	<li>Impact analysis for any changes</li>
	<li>Translate business stakeholder requirements into technical solution designs, data models, integrations, and security models</li>
	<li>Architect integrations between Adaptive planning and source/target systems</li>
	<li>Responsible for User training, Change management, Adoption</li>
	<li>Develop sheets in Adaptive Planning to capture data</li>
	<li>Design and create Levels, Period, Accounts, Version, Dimensions, Assumptions and Metadata management</li>
	<li>Ability to customize and utilize Adaptive planning allocation, consolidation, and elimination processes</li>
	<li>Develop and maintain Adaptive planning reports &amp; dashboards</li>
	<li>Develop reports using Office Connect</li>
	<li>Design and maintain security/access controls</li>
	<li>Data backup and restore</li>
</ul>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>Qualifications &amp; Skills:</p>

<ul type="disc">
	<li>Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business administration (Finance), or related field</li>
	<li>Minimum 5 years&rsquo; experience in Adaptive Planning</li>
	<li>Proficiency in financial data analysis and visualizations like monthly review deck, monthly dashboard, reports such as working capital, balance sheet, EBITDA etc.</li>
	<li>Strong understanding of accounting principles, accounting processes, and reporting.</li>
	<li>Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.</li>
	<li>Proven experience working with Adaptive planning models (e.g., RM/FG inventories, RM planning, Revenue, Working capital, Variable/Fixed cost, Capex/Depreciation, MIS etc.).</li>
	<li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively in cross-functional teams.</li>
	<li>Familiarity with ERP systems (preferably SAP) and MIS processes.</li>
	<li>Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial modeling.</li>
	<li>Experience in a corporate finance or accounting role.</li>
</ul>
